quality.review_scope: Core CdSe/PerCA4 layer-by-layer film preparation, its necessary PerCA4 precursor preparation, and directly linked product evidence. Optical n=1–5 and n=10 thickness are separate source contexts, without physical-batch joins. Upstream cited recipes and performance/control branches remain pending.
missing_fields: Reactant hydration/formulation; reaction numerical temperature, agitation and atmosphere; workup pressure, time and yield; solution-spectrum concentration and exact physical batch.
requested_tasks: Independent full audit of this core-scoped preparation; other variants remain pending.
